_note: Per-baccalaureate FEEDER TOP fields for the CPL Pathways cards. A multidisciplinary program (e.g. a management BS) draws its prior-learning credit from lower-division feeder disciplines that are coded under DIFFERENT TOP codes than the program's own. kb/_build_cpl_pathway_ccr.py assembles each program's pathway across its own TOP field PLUS these feeders, so the CPL that actually matters to the degree shows up. Keyed '<NORMCOLLEGE>|<top4>' (matching the pathway keys in cpl_pathways_ccr_data.js). This committed file is the interim form of the planned Supabase program-supplement store; a future `supplemental_courses` list (with `in_coci: false` for courses not yet in the state catalog) slots alongside `feeder_top4`.
